questions.text: What are the essential parts of a dc machine?
Classify the dc machines. Also draw their electrical equivalent circuits.
Why the armature core but not the magnetic pole core in a dc machine is constructed with laminated steel sheets instead of solid metal blocks?
What are cumulative and differentially compound dc machines?
Describe the voltage build up process of a self excited shunt generator.
List the causes for the failure of a dc generator to self excite.

A train is driven by a dc generator with separately excited field. The OCC of the machine at 1500 rpm has been measured as follows: EA (volts): 50 420 780 950 1120 1180 1260 If (A): 0 4.0 8.0 10.0 12.8 14.4 28.8 (i) Draw the OCC of the machine and determine the value of critical resistance. (ii) Why is a voltage in the armature at zero field current? (iii) Why does the induced voltage at high field currents not increase proportional to field current? (iv) What should be the field resistance for an armature induced voltage of 1000 volts?
What are base speed and back emf of a dc motor?
Explain the effect of change in shaft load on a dc shunt motor.
Why is it recommended to never unload a dc series motor while running?
Explain two basic speed control scheme of dc shunt motor.
What is armature reaction? Describe the effect of brush shifting.
What are the conditions of parallel operation of dc generators?

Two shunt wound generators running in parallel each have armature resistance of 0.03Ω and field resistance of 60Ω. The combined external load is 4500A. The field of the generators are so excited that the induced voltage of one machine is 500v & another is 510v. Calculate, (i) bus bar voltage (ii) generated power
State various advantages of stationary armature in an alternator. Also differentiate between salient and non-salient pole synchronous machines.
What is a fractional pitch winding and why is it used in synchronous machines?
Define pitch factor and distribute factor. Also derive their equations.
What is torque angle? Derive the equation of output power of a synchronous generator in terms of the torque angle of the machine.
Explain the loading effect on the generated voltage of the alternator operating at lagging pf, with necessary diagrams.

A 3-φ synchronous generator is driven by a gas turbine. The synchronous reactance/phase is 4Ω and the armature resistance is zero. It has first been connected to an infinite bus with a phase voltage of 20 kv and a frequency of 50 Hz in a proper way. (i) What do you mean by infinite bus? (ii) What are the conditions that have to be satisfied before a synchronous machine can be connected to the bus? (iii) What is the induced voltage just at the time of connecting the machine with the bus? (iv) If the field current is doubled while the power remains the same as in (iii) determine the armature current. (v) If the power is increased to 300 MW while the field current remains the same as in (iv), calculate the torque/load angle.

questions.text: What is synchronizing? Describe one method of synchronizing.
With a constant load on a synchronous motor, what are the effects produced by increasing the dc field current?
What do you mean by V-curve of a synchronous motor?
What is servo motor? Write its applications.
Explain the operation of a steeper motor.
"The speed regulation of a synchronous motor is 0% over its operating range".- Explain.
What is synchronous condenser and why is it used?
